title: main is the published line: write guard (--publish), exam publish, run-list published/dev, docs (REQ-0101)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 writes into main refused without --publish, dev lines unaffected
AC2 exam publish builds a new main report run at $0, old main runs kept; solve --line main --publish for a real run
AC3 agent rules in docs, tests keep working
AC4 run-list marks published vs dev, INDEX lists main first
AC5 announced; DGNL 2026 (f) and DHQG 2024 (t81) published into main as new runs

design.summary: one guard runlayout.require_publish refusing writes into a line named main under the repo plans/ and reports/ roots unless --publish (tests with tmp roots and plans-migrate unaffected); exam publish EXAM --from LINE builds a new main report run at $0 from the line's latest pack plan runs (run.json published_from); solve --line main --publish for a real run; run-list publish column; docs section 12; first publication of DGNL 2026 f and DHQG 2024 t81 after verification

implementation.summary: runlayout.require_publish guard on every writer of a line named main under the repo plans/ and reports/ roots, --publish flag, exam publish EXAM --from LINE (new main report run at $0, run.json published_from), solve --line main --publish, run-list publish column, exam INDEX lines table; demo on a scratch copy; real trees untouched; --fast 1844 tests, 4 known + 1 test needing an edit (test_90_5 header order)

unit_test.result: gate: ran 1883, new=[], known=4, gate_ok true, 367.8 s, worktree removed; test_publish 19 OK (guard off fails 7, pack selection off fails 3); --fast 1863 tests 54 s only the 4 known

security.result: guard refuses unpublished writes into main under the repo roots, publish builds reports only from stored results, no model call, no shell; old main runs kept and byte-unchanged

verification.command: python3 -I scripts/exam.py publish dgnl2026 --from f --key ...; publish dhqg2024 --from t81; sha256 of all reports/ and plans/ before/after; check_report_pack on both main runs; gate --full
verification.result: first publication: reports/dgnl2026/main/run-20261108-072344 (35 files, 113/120, checker 64 checks 0 failed, published_from f) and reports/dhqg2024/main/run-20261108-072402 (31 files, checker 53 checks 0 failed, published_from t81, prev_report_run the legacy main run); reports 256 -> 329 files (73 new, 0 removed, 1 regenerated INDEX.md), plans/ 1599 files identical; zero none words; gate ran 1883, new=[], known=4; verifier AC1-AC5 PASS

quality.reason: real publication into main of two exams at zero cost, with sha256 before/after of every file in reports/ and plans/, checkers on both new runs

user_notes.note: Q1-Q3 best (refuse without --publish; publish builds a new main run at zero cost; publish DGNL f and DHQG t81 now); tests use --line dev, main only on request
